newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania coffee chiefs form new association.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania coffee chiefs form new association.

text.p: Tanzania's coffee industry chiefs held the first meeting on Thursday of a newly-formed Tanzania Coffee Association designed to represent their interests to the government.
Association members include senior figures from across the industry, a spokesman said.
The new association replaces the Tanzania Coffee Traders Association, comprised solely of exporters, and aims to be the sole industry voice in discussions with the government.
"It's here to furthur Tanzania's coffee industry," said Jeremy Lefroy, Moshi-based Managing Director of the African Coffee Company Ltd (ACC) and TCA Secretary.
"The Tanzania Coffee Board's managing director needed one group of people to talk to on the industry," Lefroy told 160 participants at an annual coffee conference on Wednesday evening.
The TCA would recruit members from curing factories, buyers, liquorers, agents, producers and exporters in search of a base broader than the former organisation.
Coffee is Tanzania's single most important agricultural export earner of foreign exchange though yields are forecast to decline in 1996/97 because of poor rains.
